notes: Modified cash basis; GAAP-like net position statement with no liabilities. Top-level receipts/disbursements from Total Governmental Funds column (p4); fund columns include General fund plus Depreciation and Employee Benefit funds in the General column (all governmental, school nutrition included, no business-type funds). Beginning/ending cash are fund balances 5,308,693 to 7,339,600 (cash on hand + county treasurer). Receipts 'Other local receipts' remainder categorized charges for services/fees with review (71% Activities Fund receipts). The 490,000 Transfers from General (p9) was moved out of Other local receipts (880,884 -> 390,884, split_from) into transfers_in; printed total receipts 17,505,154 includes it (includes: transfers_in). No page shows where the 490,000 leaves the General Fund (p5 General disbursements 14,095,479 = p8 14,215,479 less the 120,000 transfer; p4 General transfers (120,000) only), so disbursements are kept as printed. Other transfers (General -120,000, Activity +20,000, Nutrition +100,000) net to zero in the total column and are not recorded at top level. Activity fund receipts 278,521 on p4 exclude the 20,000 transfer. Statement p4 labels Support services - students/instruction appear swapped vs the p7 General Fund schedule (guidance/health totals 756,784 are 'Student'; 272,366 are 'Instruction'); statement lines kept as printed. School Nutrition shown as a governmental fund in this report, so kept governmental. Detail: General Fund schedule (p6-8) records the General Fund proper (excludes Depreciation/Employee Benefit funds); its printed Grand Total of All Receipts 15,632,880 includes non-revenue 2,332; its Total Disbursements 14,215,479 includes the 120,000 transfer out (recorded as other financing -120,000). On p7 the heading over 2120-2181 is printed 'Support Services - Staff' but its subtotal reads 'Total Support Services - Student'; department recorded as Support Services - Student. General Fund budget amounts are printed only as grand totals (14,357,759 receipts; 14,606,106 disbursements), so budget_final is null per line. Activities budget 466,895 is printed on the Total Disbursements row. Combining schedule on p5 not itemized (fund totals only, duplicates p4). Pages 12, 14-18 (re-read this pass): Bond, Special Building, Qualified Capital Purpose Undertaking, Student Fee, McGrew Memorial and Contingency fund schedules recorded in detail; fund budget totals not recorded per line. Bond and Special Building 'Total receipts' printed twice (local subtotal then grand total); only the grand totals are in detail_totals. Special Building 'Other Taxes' 14,935 matches p4 Other local receipts for that fund (review). McGrew Memorial Fund (p17) is not in the p4/p5 fund columns or totals (beginning balance 'Restated' 11,099, ending 22,198); its 11,099 farm rental is recorded in detail only with review, and its expenditure line is blank ('-'), so no expenditure total. Contingency fees line is '-', so no expenditure item. Employee Benefit Fund (p10) and School Nutrition Fund (p13) schedules added after the v8 re-trim; Nutrition Transfer in from General 100,000 is inside its printed Total Revenues 509,950 (includes: other financing) and matches the General Fund 120,000 transfer out together with Activities 20,000. Detail category for expenditures is mostly 'not itemized' since schedules are by function only. Read pages 1-18 of 18 Detail rebuilt 2026-10-27 from the governmental funds statement fund columns (user: statement, not budget schedules): p4 fund columns (General incl. Depreciation and Employee Benefit funds, Activity, School Nutrition, Special Building, Bond, QCPU, Contingency, Student Fee); budget schedule lines (pp6-18) removed. General Fund printed Total receipts and transfers 16,195,244 includes the 490,000 Depreciation transfer, recorded as other financing (includes). McGrew Memorial Fund (p17, 11,099 farm rental) is not in the statement, so it is no longer in detail.
